input.title: Zions Bancorporation joins FICC GSD as Agent Clearing Member
input.summary: Zions Bancorporation, NA has been admitted as a new Agent Clearing Member (ACM Omnibus) of FICC's Government Securities Division, assigned GSD Member #94GS, per DTCC notice GOV2287-26 dated 2026-11-04.
evidence_quotes: New Agent Clearing Member of the Government Securities Division of FICC: Zions Bancorporation, NA/ACM Omnibus – GSD Member #94GS
input.notes: DTCC official notice confirming a new ACM onboarding at GSD. Relevant to FICC-GSD-03 (GSD onboarding/Sponsored volume milestones) and FICC-GSD-11 (Agent Clearing Service). Zions Bancorporation is a regional bank; not classified as a global systemically important bank, so reach is group/1 rather than major_participant/2. Summary-only content; no further detail on effective date beyond publication date.
